sections.h2: Balrampur's PLA plant is 68% through equipment erection, commissioning Oct–Dec 2026

chart.title: Design and civil work are nearly complete; equipment erection trails at 68%
chart.sub: Construction progress, % complete as of 31 July 2026.
chart.source: Balrampur Chini Mills Q1 FY27 investor presentation.

sections.means: Balrampur Chini Mills reports construction progress of 94% on model review, 92% on civil work and 68% on equipment erection at 31 July 2026.
sections.todo: Track the October–December 2026 commissioning guidance against the next investor update before treating it as settled.

sections.h2: Guided capex rose to ₹3,080 crore, and ₹2,180 crore was spent by 31 July 2026

chart.title: Capex guidance rose from ₹2,850 crore to ₹3,080 crore; ₹2,180 crore is spent
chart.source: Balrampur Chini Mills Q1 FY27 investor presentation; first announced figure as stated in this article.

sections.means: Total capex is now guided at ₹3,080 crore, up from the ₹2,850 crore first announced, with ₹2,180 crore spent as of 31 July 2026.
sections.todo: Compare the remaining spend against future quarterly capex disclosures before the commissioning date.

sections.h2: Balrampur's single plant would sit close to Total Corbion's entire Thailand capacity

chart.title: Balrampur's 75,000–80,000 TPA would sit close to TotalEnergies Corbion's 75,000 t/year
chart.sub: Annual PLA capacity, tonnes per year.
chart.source: Figures as stated in this article.

sections.means: NatureWorks has about 225,000 t/year from US corn-based production, while TotalEnergies Corbion has about 75,000 t/year from its Thailand plant.
